title: Proficiency
summary: Upon accumulation of Satisfaction, Proficiency Level will increase and special characteristics will be activated.

sections.note: Levels go up with the Satisfaction added up over all runs; every unlocked bonus stays on.

rows.text: Reduce Restriction Time for Wrong Orders
rows.sub: Reduces the action restriction time when the maid serves the wrong food.
Increases the waiting time after the customer orders.

rows: Customers eat in 50% of the time
